credentials.helpBody:
1. Link your app account
  1. Log in to the Tuya Developer Platform and open your project under Cloud > Development.
  2. Go to the Devices tab and click Link Tuya App Account.
  3. Click Add App Account and scan the QR code with your Smart Life / Tuya app (Profile > QR code scanner, top right).
  4. Confirm the link in the app. Your devices will appear under All Devices.
2. Find the Device ID
  1. In your project go to Cloud > Devices > All Devices.
  2. Find your device in the list. The Device ID is shown directly below the device name — copy it.
3. Read the Local Key via API Explorer
  1. In the left sidebar click Cloud > API Explorer.
  2. In the left menu select Smart Home Management System > Device Management > Query Device Details.
  3. Select the correct Data Center in the top right (e.g. "Central Europe Data Center").
  4. Enter your Device ID in the input field and click Submit Request.
  5. In the JSON response look for the field local_key — that is your local encryption key.

list_devices.dpHint: DP numbers can be changed directly — the current value updates live.

smart_plug.energyNote: 0 = app computes kWh from power readings (recommended). Set to 17 only if your device provides a reliable local energy counter.

ev.phaseANote: Raw DP providing voltage, current and power in one packet. Both 8-byte and 7-byte layouts are handled automatically.
ev.powerTotal: Total Power W (0 = use Phase A)
ev.energyTotalNote: Leave at 0 if your charger's lifetime counter never updates locally — the total is then accumulated from the session counter, which works on every model.

errors.missing_settings: Device settings incomplete — check IP address, Device ID and Local Key.
errors.dpNotConfigured: This data point is not configured on this device ({{setting}}) — set its DP number in the device settings first.
errors.lockControlDisabled: Locking and unlocking from Homey is switched off for this device. Turn on "Allow locking and unlocking from Homey" in the device settings after checking that the lock state reads correctly.
errors.pickAgain: That step is no longer one this heater offers — open the flow and pick the level again.
